- PD-8841: from the 4/27 digest. It may be the same problem as #8841, but I didn't link them.
- PD-4418: from the 9/15/2025 digest. That digest doesn't name the account, so I inferred Vantorre Group.
- INC-4821: from #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3.
- VT-55120: from #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14. In that thread I first wrote that I had logged it, then corrected myself. I haven't logged or changed anything.

I also posted a correction: I read 10 digest and cheat-sheet files, not the 13 my first message claimed. I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812. The list is ticket numbers and sources only. I can't check them against the ticketing system, so the #8841 status needs confirming before it goes to Mateo's steering committee.
